visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with light brown hair pulled back in a ponytail wearing a white knitted cardigan decorated with small red bows speaks directly into the camera. She stands in a bright room with a white wall behind her. A small black DJI lavalier microphone is clipped to her collar. Her expressions are lively and engaging as she gestures with her hands while speaking. (2) The camera switches to a perspective inside a closet area, showing rows of white and neutral-toned clothing hanging on wooden hangers. A hand enters the frame to touch and shift several lightweight down jackets in shades of beige and grey. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the fabrics and the organized nature of the wardrobe. (3) The woman holds up a thin, beige, collarless down jacket on a wooden hanger, pointing towards its neck area to emphasize the design. She is standing in a room with a white wardrobe and a mirror. On the shelves behind her, several designer bags and accessories are visible. The scene has a clean, domestic aesthetic with soft indoor lighting. (4) The woman puts on the beige collarless jacket and turns her back to the camera, showcasing the fit and length. She then turns back around, stretching her arms upwards to demonstrate the flexibility and comfort of the garment. The background remains consistent, featuring a white door and a portion of her dressing table with various beauty products. (5) She presents two additional beige down jackets, both with hoods, holding them side-by-side to compare their lengths and styles. One is a shorter model from UNIQLO, while the other is a longer version from the brand 23區. She then tries on the longer hooded jacket, showing how it cinches at the waist to create a more feminine silhouette. (6) The creator holds up a black quilted down jacket with a wavy, non-linear stitching pattern. She explains why she chose a black option to contrast her mostly light-colored wardrobe. She puts the jacket on, displaying the front and then the back view, highlighting the unique texture and collarless design which she prefers for layering. (7) The video concludes with the woman returning to her original speaking position, facing the camera. She continues her narrative about minimalist wardrobe habits, gesturing with two fingers to signify the remaining four jackets. The lighting stays bright and warm, maintaining the friendly and informative vlog style throughout the final seconds.
